clues: This town sits in the heart of its land, high up in the Andes. It stands on a high flat plain in the east part of the range.
High in the mountains, the climate stays cool and even all year. Dry seasons and rainy seasons take turns.
On 6 Aug 1538, a man from Spain set up this town as the chief town of a new realm. He had marched through the Andes and won the land in hard fights.
A hall in this town holds more old gold than any place on earth. It guards 35,000 bits of gold, and 30,000 more works in stone, clay, and cloth.
Colombia is run from this town, the seat of rule for the whole land. More folk live here than in any other town in the land by far.
